name: Vector Search
description: INSERT 1536-dimension vectors and run cosine similarity searches

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bench_documents (id INT8 PRIMARY KEY, title STRING NOT NULL, content STRING NOT NULL, embedding FLOAT8[] NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
CREATE VECTOR INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bench_docs_embedding ON bench_documents (embedding vector_cosine_ops)

operations.name: vector_search
sql: SELECT id, title, (SELECT sum(a.v * b.v) FROM unnest(embedding) WITH ORDINALITY AS a(v, i), unnest($1::FLOAT8[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS b(v, i) WHERE a.i = b.i) AS similarity FROM bench_documents ORDER BY similarity DESC LIMIT 10

operations.name: vector_insert
sql: INSERT INTO bench_documents (id, title, content, embedding) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::FLOAT8[])
